crossRefs.note: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.
translations.bsb: In the second month, a very great assembly gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
translations.kjv: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
translations.asv: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.
